blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — The father of slain nursing student Altheia Maru Gabayno died of cardiac arrest early Tuesday (Nov. 17), two days after his daughter was laid to rest, as the family continued to grieve her brutal killing. Roden Gabayno, 47, a barangay councilor of Barangay Labonan in Bongabong, was rushed to the Oriental Mindoro Southern District Hospital in Roxas town after experiencing difficulty breathing while asleep at around dawn, according to his cousin, Toto Gabayno.
